subject_depth.reason: Gap-directed evidence improved coverage but one or more core subject dimensions remain insufficient.

restrictions.subject: technical GSM, absorbency and construction-performance relationships
restrictions.reason: The evidence pack marks technical depth WARN and lacks sufficient independent corroboration.
restrictions.permitted_treatment: Explain the measurement or construction as an observed/qualified consideration and preserve source limitations.
restrictions.prohibited_treatment: Do not state a universal technical relationship or imply that one metric determines performance.

restrictions.subject: manufacturer descriptions of towel designs and benefits
restrictions.reason: These records are manufacturer-owned observations or marketing claims.
restrictions.permitted_treatment: Attribute the description to the manufacturer or present it as a market example.
restrictions.prohibited_treatment: Do not promote manufacturer claims to objective category facts.

restrictions.subject: customer and practitioner experiences
restrictions.reason: Community evidence records experience and concerns, not technical consensus.
restrictions.permitted_treatment: Use as attributed concerns, questions or examples of user experience.
restrictions.prohibited_treatment: Do not state anecdotes as universal practice, preference or performance proof.

restrictions.subject: universal superiority and best-in-market claims
restrictions.reason: The pack contains no evidence establishing universal superiority and explicitly preserves uncertainty.
restrictions.permitted_treatment: Describe the available options and qualified decision criteria.
restrictions.prohibited_treatment: Do not claim that any construction, GSM range or product is universally best.

evidence_limitations: Community questions indicate concerns but do not establish technical truth.
